script_text: Stop, Aries, something is cracking open in your foundation right now. Mars in Leo is squaring Saturn at seventeen degrees Aries, and with the Sun crossing zero degrees Gemini, you feel a sharp tension in your 1st House of self. Saturn demands you stop running and own your authority. Venus slips into your 5th House, lighting a spark with someone whose laugh you can't ignore. But in your 10th House of career, Jupiter in Cancer opposes that Saturn, and a financial offer may look golden but carries strings. Resist signing anything before Friday. Meanwhile Neptune conjunct Saturn gifts you a quiet flash of intuitive clarity you did not expect. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you stay ahead of what's shifting this week.
